jobs.title: Artificial Intelligence Engineer
jobs.description: Job Title: AI Engineer Generative AI, RAG & Agentic AI Experience: 612 Years Remote Key Roles and Responsibilities Design, develop, and deploy enterprise-grade Generative AI applications using Large Language Models (LLMs), Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), and Agentic AI architectures. Build end-to-end RAG pipelines, including document ingestion, parsing, preprocessing, chunking, embedding generation, vector indexing, retrieval, reranking, and context-grounded response generation. Develop automated document-processing pipelines to extract and normalize information from PDFs, Word documents, Excel workbooks, scanned files, tables, forms, and other structured and unstructured data sources. Implement OCR, layout detection, table extraction, schema mapping, and data validation to handle heterogeneous document formats, complex tables, merged cells, multi-level headers, and inconsistent data structures. Design and optimize vector search, keyword search, hybrid retrieval, metadata filtering, query rewriting, semantic search, and reranking strategies to improve retrieval accuracy and relevance. Develop prompt engineering strategies, structured outputs, function calling, and context-management techniques to improve LLM response quality, consistency, and reliability. Evaluate and select appropriate LLMs and embedding models based on accuracy, reasoning capabilities, context-window size, latency, throughput, cost, security, and deployment requirements. Implement LLM application tracing, evaluation, and observability using LangSmith or equivalent tools to monitor prompts, model calls, retrieval operations, tool executions, latency, token usage, and errors. Use MLflow or equivalent platforms for experiment tracking, evaluation management, configuration comparison, artifact versioning, and reproducible AI development workflows. Develop evaluation datasets and automated testing pipelines to measure answer correctness, faithfulness, contextual relevance, retrieval performance, citation accuracy, and structured-output validity. Identify and mitigate LLM hallucinations through evidence-grounded generation, source validation, citation verification, confidence-based controls, deterministic validation, and abstention mechanisms. Design and implement Agentic AI workflows using LangGraph, LangChain, LlamaIndex, or similar frameworks to integrate LLMs with APIs, databases, enterprise tools, and business processes. Implement agent orchestration, workflow routing, state management, tool calling, retries, error handling, and human-in-the-loop approval mechanisms where required. Develop scalable backend services and AI APIs using Python, FastAPI, REST APIs, and related technologies to integrate AI capabilities into enterprise applications. Optimize AI application performance, including retrieval quality, inference latency, token consumption, throughput, caching, concurrency, and overall operational cost. Deploy and maintain AI applications on cloud platforms such as Microsoft Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud, using Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD pipelines, and appropriate deployment practices. Implement security controls, authentication, authorization, data privacy, prompt injection protection, sensitive-data handling, audit logging, and responsible AI practices. Monitor production AI applications, investigate quality degradation and failures, perform root-cause analysis, and implement continuous improvement through evaluation results and user feedback. Collaborate with data engineers, ML engineers, architects, DevOps teams, and business stakeholders to translate requirements into scalable, secure, and reliable AI solutions. Maintain technical documentation, automated tests, reusable components, version control, and engineering best practices throughout the AI application lifecycle. Requirements 6–12 years of overall experience in software engineering, AI/ML engineering, data engineering, or related technical domains, with hands-on experience developing AI-powered applications. Strong programming skills in Python, including application development, API integration, data processing, debugging, testing, and exception handling. Hands-on experience building and deploying Generative AI applications using LLM APIs or open-source language models. Strong understanding of RAG architecture, document ingestion, text preprocessing, chunking strategies, embeddings, vector databases, retrieval optimization, and grounded response generation. Practical experience with LLM orchestration frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, or LlamaIndex. Experience with vector databases and search technologies such as Azure AI Search, Pinecone, Qdrant, Weaviate, Chroma, FAISS, Elasticsearch, or OpenSearch. Hands-on experience with prompt engineering, structured output generation, function calling, context management, and LLM integration. Experience processing structured and unstructured documents, including PDFs, Excel files, Word documents, scanned documents, and complex tables, using document parsers, OCR, and document intelligence technologies. Knowledge of table extraction, schema normalization, metadata management, data quality validation, and document versioning. Practical experience with LangSmith, MLflow, or equivalent platforms for LLM tracing, experiment tracking, evaluation, observability, and performance optimization. Strong understanding of LLM evaluation methodologies, including retrieval precision and recall, answer correctness, faithfulness, contextual relevance, citation validation, and regression testing. Experience implementing hallucination mitigation, evidence validation, confidence thresholds, fallback mechanisms, and safe abstention strategies. Understanding of LLM and embedding model selection based on accuracy, latency, cost, context length, multilingual capabilities, privacy, and deployment constraints. Experience integrating AI applications with REST APIs, SQL/NoSQL databases, enterprise systems, and external tools. Knowledge of Agentic AI concepts, tool calling, workflow orchestration, state management, and multi-step LLM execution. Familiarity with cloud AI platforms such as Azure OpenAI, Azure AI Foundry, Amazon Bedrock, or Google Vertex AI. Experience with Git, Docker, CI/CD, automated testing, application logging, monitoring, and production deployment practices. Understanding of AI security, access control, data privacy, prompt injection risks, sensitive-data protection, and responsible AI principles. Strong analytical, problem-solving, debugging, communication, and collaboration skills, with the ability to deliver production-ready AI solutions. 6-11 Yrs Huggingface, Python, Kernel, OCR, Artificial Intelligence, Microsoft Flow, Microsoft, Data Ingestion

jobs.description: Role & responsibilities Develop, modify, troubleshoot, and optimize PLC programs for manufacturing and automation equipment. Experience in troubleshooting PLC-controlled production lines, robotic systems, HMIs, SCADA, VFDs, and Servo Drives. Exposure to preventive, predictive, and breakdown maintenance of automated manufacturing equipment. Knowledge of industrial communication protocols such as Profibus, Profinet, Ethernet/IP, and Modbus. Strong problem-solving, fault-finding, and Root Cause Analysis (RCA) skills. Familiarity with TPM, Kaizen, 5S, and continuous improvement initiatives. Experience in automotive welding, robotic automation, press shop, assembly lines, or BIW operations will be preferred. Ability to work in shifts and handle critical machine breakdowns independently. Good communication, teamwork, and coordination skills. 3-6 Yrs Programming, Plant, Plant maintenance, Breakdown maintenance, Engineering, Program, Maintenance, SR

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer
jobs.description: About Sirion Sirion is the worlds leading AI-native Contract Lifecycle Management (CLM) platform . Global enterprises use Sirion to author, negotiate, manage, and extract value from their contracts, using generative AI for extraction, conversational search, and AI-assisted negotiation. With more than 7 million contracts and close to $800B in contract value under management, Sirion is recognized as a leader by Gartner, IDC, and Spend Matters. Power the Future of AI & Why This Role Matters We are looking for an AI Automation Engineer with 4–6 years of Python development experience and hands-on experience building AI-powered and agentic automation solutions . The ideal candidate combines strong Python backend skills with practical knowledge of LLMs, AI agents, RAG, tool calling, and workflow orchestration . As part of Sirion’s Automation team, you will design, build, and deploy intelligent automations in which AI agents reason over contracts and business data, call APIs and tools, and execute multi-step processes end-to-end, with appropriate human-in-the-loop controls. How You’ll Make an Impact Design, develop, and deploy agentic AI automations that use LLMs, tool/function calling, memory, and multi-step reasoning to automate business processes end-to-end. Build agent workflows using frameworks such as LangGraph, LangChain, CrewAI, AutoGen , or similar. Build AI agents that interact with APIs, databases, documents, web applications, and external tools . Design and implement RAG-based solutions using embeddings, vector databases, and semantic search. Integrate OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, or other LLM APIs into production systems, including prompt engineering and structured outputs. Develop scalable backend services and APIs in Python using FastAPI, Flask, or Django REST Framework . Build human-in-the-loop checkpoints, guardrails, and error-handling/retry logic so automations run reliably in production. Develop asynchronous and event-driven workflows where required. Evaluate agent quality, accuracy, latency, and cost; monitor, troubleshoot, and optimize automations in production. Work with databases such as PostgreSQL, MySQL, MongoDB, or Redis . Deploy and maintain solutions using Docker and CI/CD pipelines . Write clean, maintainable, testable, production-ready Python code. Collaborate with product managers, architects, business stakeholders, and engineering teams to identify automation opportunities and translate requirements into technical solutions. Stay current with developments in Generative AI and Agentic AI . Skills & Experience You Bring to the Table Python & Backend Development 4–6 years of professional experience in Python development . Strong understanding of OOP, data structures, exception handling, and concurrency (asyncio/threading) . Hands-on experience with FastAPI, Flask, Django, or Django REST Framework . Strong experience developing and consuming REST APIs . Good understanding of SQL and relational databases ( PostgreSQL/MySQL ); MongoDB/Redis experience preferred. Agentic AI / GenAI Hands-on experience building LLM-powered applications beyond proofs of concept. Understanding of agentic AI architecture , including planning, tool use, memory, and autonomous multi-step workflows. Experience with one or more agent frameworks such as LangGraph, LangChain, CrewAI, or AutoGen . Experience with tool/function calling and integrating external APIs and tools with LLMs. Understanding of RAG, embeddings, vector databases, and semantic search . Experience with LLM APIs such as OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, or equivalent . Good understanding of prompt engineering and structured LLM outputs . Experience with MCP (Model Context Protocol) and AI tool integrations. Experience building multi-agent systems . Cloud & DevOps Experience with Docker and containerized applications. Understanding of CI/CD pipelines and tools such as Jenkins, GitHub Actions, or GitLab CI. Exposure to AWS, Azure, or GCP . Experience with logging, monitoring, debugging, and production deployments. Education & Soft Skills Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Electronics, Engineering, or a related field . Strong problem-solving and analytical skills. Ability to work independently and collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams. Strong communication and documentation skills. Good to Have Experience with RPA or workflow automation platforms such as UiPath, Automation Anywhere, Power Automate, or n8n . Experience with document AI : extracting and processing data from PDFs, contracts, or other unstructured documents. Exposure to Contract Lifecycle Management (CLM) or enterprise SaaS platforms. Experience with task and message queues such as Celery, RabbitMQ, or Kafka . Experience with Kubernetes . Experience working with open-source/local LLMs and Hugging Face models. Understanding of LLM evaluation, observability, guardrails, and cost optimization . Basic understanding of frontend technologies such as React, JavaScript, HTML, and CSS . What We Are Looking For The ideal candidate is strong in Python backend development and has built real AI/agentic automation solutions , not just theoretical knowledge of Generative AI. Candidates should be able to demonstrate projects that combine LLMs + tools/APIs + orchestration + backend services , preferably deployed in production. Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion We are an equal opportunity employer committed to diversity and inclusion. We do not discriminate on the basis of any characteristic protected by law, and we provide reasonable accommodations for applicants with disabilities. These principles apply across all of our employment practices. Excited About This Opportunity? We’d love to hear from you! Apply through the Sirion Careers page and follow the steps listed there. 4-7 Yrs Fullstack Development, Python, Senior, Software, Full Stack, Stack, Development

jobs.title: AI Automation Engineer
jobs.description: About us We're a small, fast-growing digital marketing agency, and we're betting big on AI to run a leaner, smarter business. We want to automate the repetitive work across support, sales and customer success so our team can focus on strategy, creativity and clients. You'll be the person who makes that happen. The role We're hiring a full-time AI Automation Expert to design, build and maintain AI-powered systems across the agency. You'll work hands-on with Claude Code and Grok (xAI) to turn manual workflows into reliable automations, connect them to our tools (Go High Level & Monday.com), and keep improving them as we grow. This is a builder role with real ownership. You'll scope problems with team leads, ship working solutions quickly, and document them so the team can use them every day. What you'll build Your first projects will cover three areas of the business, with plenty more to follow. AI support ticketing system: an intake, triage and routing system that categorizes client requests, drafts responses and escalates to the right person. Sales lead sourcing bot: a bot that finds and qualifies prospects that match our ideal client profile, enriches their data and pushes them into our pipeline. Customer success call intelligence: automations that capture client call data (summaries, action items, sentiment, upsell signals) and organize it in Monday.com. Whatever comes next: reporting, campaign workflows, internal tools and any process where AI can save time or improve quality. Responsibilities Audit our workflows across support, sales and customer success, and identify the highest-impact automation opportunities. Design, build, test and deploy AI automations using Claude Code, Grok and related APIs. Integrate AI systems with our tools, especially Monday.com, & Go High Level plus email, call recording, calendar and lead data platforms. Build prompts, agents and workflows that are reliable, monitored and easy to update. Write clear documentation and train team members to use what you build. Track results (time saved, response times, leads generated) and iterate based on feedback. Handle client and company data securely and responsibly. Stay current on new AI tools and recommend the ones worth adopting. Requirements Proven hands-on experience building with Claude Code and the Grok (xAI) API. Please show us real projects. 2+ years building automations, integrations or software, ideally for business operations. Strong skills in Python and/or JavaScript/TypeScript, REST APIs, webhooks and JSON. Experience integrating with CRMs or work management platforms. Monday.com & GHL experience is a big plus. Solid prompt engineering and experience building AI agents or multi-step workflows. Able to take a loosely defined business problem and turn it into a working, documented solution. Clear written and spoken English, and comfortable explaining technical work to non-technical teammates. Available to work 9am-5pm Eastern Time, Monday to Friday. Nice to have Experience at or with a digital marketing agency. Familiarity with automation platforms such as Make, Zapier or n8n. Experience with call recording and transcription tools (e.g., Fathom) or speech-to-text APIs. Lead enrichment and scraping tools (e.g., Apollo, Clay) and an understanding of data privacy rules. Experience with helpdesk platforms or building ticketing systems. Compensation, hours and location Pay: $1,500 - $2,500 USD per month, based on experience Hours: Full-time, 9am-5pm Eastern Time (EST/EDT), MondayFriday Location: Remote Hiring process Our process ends with a paid, real-world project so you can show what you can build, and we can see how you work. Application review: we review your application and portfolio of AI automation work. Intro call (30 min): a conversation about your background, tools and how you approach automation problems. Technical interview ( 30 min): a walkthrough of a past project you built with Claude Code or Grok. Paid final project (top 3 candidates): you'll build a working AI support ticketing system prototype for our agency. You'll be paid for your time, and we'll provide a brief, success criteria and a deadline. Final review and offer: you'll present your project, and we'll choose the best fit for the team. 0-6 Yrs Automation engineering, Automation, Artificial Intelligence, Workflow, Python, Workflow Automation, Integration, Zapier

jobs.title: Analytics Engineer-Senior AI / RAG Platform Engineer
jobs.description: Job Description Experience Level: 5+ Years Work Arrangement: Hybrid / Remote Flexible Executive Overview We are looking for an experienced, hands-on Senior AI & RAG Platform Engineer with 5+ years of software engineering and applied AI experience to lead the architecture, configuration, optimisation, and production deployment of our generative AI capabilities. In this role, you will be the technical owner responsible for designing advanced Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines, managing vector indexing and retrieval lifecycle, orchestrating foundation models (both open-source and proprietary), and embedding these AI services natively into our in-house custom-developed platform. Key Responsibilities 1. Advanced RAG Architecture & Pipeline Configuration • End-to-End Retrieval Pipelines: Design, configure, and optimise enterprise RAG pipelines combining dense vector search, sparse keyword search (BM25), reciprocal rank fusion (RRF), and cross-encoder reranking models (Cohere Rerank, BGE). • Document Parsing & ETL: Build robust ingestion workflows for parsing, segmenting, and embedding multi-format documents (PDFs, Markdown, relational data, APIs) with semantic chunking and hierarchy preservation. • Vector Lifecycle & Operations: Configure and maintain production vector databases (e.g., pgvector, Qdrant, Pinecone, Milvus, Weaviate), including multi-tenant partitioning, payload indexing, and HNSW index tuning. 2. AI Model Selection, Orchestration & Agents • Model Integration: Evaluate, select, and configure foundation models (OpenAI GPT-4o, Anthropic Claude 3.5, Llama 3.1/3.3, Mistral) based on cost, context limits, latency, and task complexity. • Agentic Workflows & Tool Calling: Implement structured schema decoding (JSON/Pydantic), function calling, and multi-step agentic execution flows (using LangGraph, LlamaIndex, or custom workflows). • Fine-Tuning & Serving (Optional/Targeted): Conduct parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT / LoRA / QLoRA) when necessary, and deploy open-weight models via inference servers such as vLLM, TensorRT-LLM, or Ollama. 3. Custom Platform Integration & Engineering • API & Microservice Development: Design and expose scalable REST, gRPC, and WebSocket streaming endpoints using Python (FastAPI, asyncio) to interface between LLM workflows and our proprietary platform microservices. • State & Memory Management: Build sliding-window conversational memory, persistent session tracking, semantic caching (Redis / GPTCache), and tenant-level access control at the retrieval boundary. • Async & Event-Driven Processing: Integrate heavy inference and document embedding pipelines into distributed message brokers and queues (Celery, Kafka, RabbitMQ, SQS). 4. LLMOps, Guardrails & Quality Assurance • Quantitative Evaluation: Establish continuous RAG evaluation frameworks (Ragas, TruLens, DeepEval) tracking Faithfulness, Answer Relevance, Context Precision, and Hallucination rates. • Guardrails & Security: Implement strict guardrails (NeMo Guardrails, Llama Guard), prompt-injection mitigation, PII masking, and data privacy governance. • Observability: Track latency, token utilization, rate limits, and end-to-end trace flows using Langfuse, Arize Phoenix, LangSmith, or OpenTelemetry. Candidate Requirements & Qualifications Must-Have Requirements • 5+ years of professional backend/software engineering experience, with primary expertise in Python (FastAPI, Pydantic, asyncio, multiprocessing). • 2+ years of hands-on experience designing and operating RAG pipelines and production LLM-based solutions. • Deep practical knowledge of AI orchestration frameworks: LlamaIndex, LangChain, LangGraph, or custom agent engines. • Production experience with vector databases (e.g., pgvector, Qdrant, Pinecone, Weaviate, Milvus). • Strong background in microservices architecture, RESTful/gRPC design, WebSocket streaming for token generation, and distributed caching (Redis). • Experience with relational databases (PostgreSQL) and query performance tuning. • Proficient in Docker, container orchestration (Kubernetes), CI/CD, and major cloud ecosystems (AWS, GCP, or Azure). • Familiarity with RAG evaluation metrics and debugging hallucination/grounding issues. Preferred / Nice-to-Have • Experience deploying high-concurrency LLM inference backends using vLLM or TensorRT-LLM. • Experience with Row-Level Security (RLS) and Role-Based Access Control (RBAC) applied to vector knowledge bases. • Background in embedding model domain adaptation or LoRA fine-tuning. • Prior experience working within custom SaaS or internal enterprise platforms. Target Technical Stack Domain Technologies Languages & Frameworks Python 3.11+, FastAPI, Pydantic, asyncio, Node.js (secondary) RAG & Orchestration LlamaIndex, LangChain, LangGraph, DSPy, Unstructured.io Vector DBs & Search pgvector (PostgreSQL), Qdrant, Pinecone, Weaviate, BM25 / OpenSearch LLMs & Embeddings OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, Llama 3.1/3.3, Mistral, BGE / Voyage Embeddings LLMOps & Evaluation Ragas, TruLens, Langfuse, Arize Phoenix, NeMo Guardrails Infrastructure Docker, Kubernetes, Redis, RabbitMQ/Kafka, AWS/GCP, Terraform 5-10 Yrs RAG Architecture, Artificial Intelligence, Open AI, API, Open, Analytics, Intelligence, Architecture
